nodes.label: ADR 0185: The cache of songs that left is tidied
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home's cache was 33 GB, 24 GB of it analyses of songs no longer in GLUE (written 2026-09-28 to 10-03 while the collection was set up). Nothing had ever removed a song's cache. Decision: 5 minutes after start, then daily, GLUE Home removes cache files whose song is not in the collection, keeping files written in the last two days and never tidying a collection it cannot fully read.

nodes.label: tidy_cache (GLUE Home service)
nodes.rationale: Runs 5 minutes after GLUE Home starts, then daily; reports what it freed in Activity. Keeps a collection it cannot fully read and one without a collection.json in this GLUE folder.

nodes.label: Cache of songs no longer in GLUE
nodes.rationale: Songs leave by removal, joins, shared sync from another device or a moved collection, and their cache was never removed. A sweep against the collection's song ids catches all causes, including cache from before the change. Rejected: removing per song at removal time, which misses the rest.

nodes.label: follow_moves
nodes.rationale: Copied a moved collection's cache to the collection it went into and left the original; now a moved collection's whole cache is removed.
